example.title: Seafood restaurant on the Santa Cruz Municipal Wharf
example.place: Santa Cruz, Santa Cruz County, CA

brief: A 1980s wharf restaurant standing on the timber deck of the municipal wharf: two storeys of white-painted siding, a fully glazed upper dining room with teal-painted window frames and a low teal metal roof with a lantern mast, a railed deck and benches along the wharf edge. One photo. Wharf piles 10 m below the bed (spec rule 4).
label: Fishing Pier
